mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_result (user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, ai_score, ai_suggestion, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionnaireId}, #{answers}, #{aiScore}, #{aiSuggestion}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, ai_score, ai_suggestion, create_time, update_time FROM assessment_result WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, questionnaire_id, answers, ai_score, ai_suggestion, create_time, update_time FROM assessment_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_result SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.user_id AS userId, u.phone, u.real_name AS realName, a.questionnaire_id AS questionnaireId, q.title AS questionnaireTitle, a.ai_score AS aiScore, a.ai_suggestion AS aiSuggestion, a.create_time AS createTime FROM assessment_result a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN questionnaire q ON a.questionnaire_id = q.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id ASC
